## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user problem, what changes, and any related issue.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For detector changes, include representative
evaluation results and known failure cases, not only synthetic unit tests.

## Compatibility and data

Describe API/CLI changes, calibration changes, dependencies, or data handling changes.

- [ ] Documentation reflects the resulting behavior.
- [ ] Relevant lint and tests pass, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Included images/data have permission to be shared and contain no sensitive data.
